name: Ziprasidone
aliases: CP-88059, CP-88059-27, CP-880591, CP-8805927, Geodon, Geodon®, Ziprasidona, Ziprasidonum
summary: Ziprasidone, sold under the brand name Geodon among others, is an atypical antipsychotic used to treat schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. It may be used by mouth and by injection into a muscle (IM). The intramuscular form may be used for acute agitation in people with schizophrenia.
